defective_pattern: Injecting <w:jc w:val='right'/> alongside <w:bidi w:val='1'/>, omitting w:jc w:val='both' for narrative paragraphs, using append() for bidiVisual, leaving acronyms in English in preamble copies, and using brittle heading regex for chapter detection.
why_defective: Violates OpenXML BiDi Golden Rule (causes trailing-edge flip inversion). Violates CT_TblPr schema ordering. Fails formatting standards (ragged text, English acronyms).
observed_symptoms: Headings aligned left instead of right.
Narrative paragraphs not justified (missing w:jc w:val='both').
Invalid OpenXML table schema due to w:bidiVisual positioned after w:tblW.
Untranslated English acronyms in preamble tables.
corrective_remedy: Strip w:jc elements from RTL headings/titles when w:bidi=1. Enforce w:jc w:val='both' on narrative. Sanitize acronyms. Insert bidiVisual at the beginning of tblPr using insert(0, ...). Differentiate chapter titles from internal section headings.
